# Tamery

> Tamery is an AI-powered, open-source database client for PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, MySQL, MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, ClickHouse, MongoDB and SQLite, including Turso and Cloudflare D1. It lets developers write queries, explore and edit data, and manage databases with AI doing the heavy lifting. Available as a native desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, a web app and a CLI, with a local MCP server for AI agents.

## Key facts

- Supported databases: PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, MySQL, MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL), Oracle, ClickHouse, MongoDB (including Atlas), SQLite, Turso, Cloudflare D1
- Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows, Linux (DEB, RPM, AppImage), web
- Open source under AGPL-3.0: https://github.com/wannabespace/tamery
- Install via Homebrew: `brew install --cask tamery`

## Pages

- [Home](https://tamery.app/): Product overview, features, pricing and FAQ
- [Download](https://tamery.app/download): Download links for macOS, Windows and Linux
- [Releases](https://tamery.app/releases): Changelog and version history
- [Blog](https://tamery.app/blog): Longer stories and reasoning behind Tamery
- [How to connect to SQL Server](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-sql-server): Connection string, trusted connections vs SQL auth, the sa account
- [How to connect to PostgreSQL](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-postgresql): Connection string, poolers, placeholder passwords, SSL modes
- [How to connect to MySQL](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-mysql): URL, Go DSN and .env formats, SSL, auth plugin errors
- [How to connect to Oracle](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-oracle): Connection string and JDBC URL, service name, schemas, TCPS, limits
- [How to connect to ClickHouse](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-clickhouse): HTTP interface, ports, HTTPS string, differences from a row store
- [How to connect to SQLite](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-sqlite): Drag and drop, paths and schemes, reaching a local file from the web
- [How to connect to Turso](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-turso): libSQL database URL and auth token, self-hosted servers
- [How to connect to Cloudflare D1](https://tamery.app/blog/connect-to-cloudflare-d1): Account ID, database ID, API token, D1 quirks
- [Privacy Policy](https://tamery.app/privacy-policy): How Tamery handles your data
- [Terms of Service](https://tamery.app/terms-of-service): Terms and conditions
